reason: Having someone come to the house while the kids nap is honestly tempting, but ₱1,800 is almost double what I pay for gel art at the mall, and I can't justify that every month or two on our budget. I also haven't seen their portfolio yet, and I pick artists by their work.
objection: ₱1,800 is a lot for regular nails, and the ad says 'sanitized kit' but doesn't tell me how the tools are sterilized. I don't want to risk an infection from a new home-service business I know nothing about.
would_change_my_mind: A first-booking price closer to ₱1,000 to ₱1,200, plus an Instagram or TikTok page with real client nails and a video showing how they sterilize their tools.
